==Description==
The '''Eggveloper Cannon 9002''' was a gear published to the Roblox catalog on the 30th of March 2020, specifically for the Roblox event, [[w:c:roblox:Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.|Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.]] Developers working on games involved in the [[w:c:roblox:Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.|Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.]] got the '''Eggveloper Cannon 9002''' on the 3rd of April 2020. As Tower Defense Simulator was part of this event, this gear had some use in the game. You can no longer use this gear in Tower Defense Simulator.

==Usage==
Using the '''Eggveloper Cannon 9002''', you could shoot out the [[w:c:Roblox:Catalog:Eggveloper Egg of "X,Y,Z"|Eggveloper Egg of "X,Y,Z"]] for all players to obtain.

==Trivia==
*Only developers of Paradoxum Games got the '''Eggveloper Cannon 9002'''. These people were:
**BelowNatural
**Razuatix
**Beefchoplets
**Bisyeet
**Jaaziar
*Only developers working on games involved in the [[w:c:roblox:Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.|Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.]] and Quality Assurance Testers can own this gear.
*The '''Eggveloper Cannon 9002''' could only be used in the Tower Defense Simulator lobby between the 6th of April 2020, and the 29th of April 2020.
**Developers that owned this gear, but not involved in the development of Tower Defense Simulator, could still equip it in the Tower Defense Simulator lobby.
**After 29 April 2020, the '''Eggveloper Cannon 9002''' could no longer be used, although the [[Spring 2020 Event]] still continued.
*The '''Eggveloper Cannon 9002''' can still be used in other games that allow for it, though its primary function is now depreciated.
*On the Roblox website, the 3D view of the '''Eggveloper Cannon 9002''' is glitched.
*''Eggveloper'' is a portmanteau of "egg" and "developer".
